description: This file defines an abstract class 'Plugins_Reports' for report plugins in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for report configuration, execution, and metadata, and references various external files and classes related to report handling and permissions.

classes.name: Plugins_Reports
classes.description: An abstract class for report plugins, providing interface methods for report configuration, execution, and metadata, utilizing traits and external classes for permissions, translation, and date handling.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Calls initInfo() and returns the plugin's information array.

methods.name: initInfo
methods.description: Abstract method to set plugin's private variables with plugin details.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Abstract method to return default configuration for the report.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Abstract method to save user report settings to session.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the report, returning error code on failure.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns error message string for a given error code.

methods.name: _getReportParametersForDisplay
methods.description: Abstract method to return report worksheet sub-heading parameters.

methods.name: infoArray
methods.description: Returns an array with plugin metadata, including name, description, category, author, export format, authorized users, and import configuration.

methods.name: isAllowedToExecute
methods.description: Checks if current user has permission to run the report.

methods.name: _prepareReportRange
methods.description: Prepares report date range info from OA_Admin_DaySpan object, with fallback to database start date.

methods.name: _getReportFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for the report based on plugin name and date range.

methods.name: _getDisplayableParametersFromDaySpan
methods.description: Returns start and end date parameters for display in report worksheet.
